source: Fitted by scripts/fit_gather_row.py from 385 recorded gather steps on the author's own corpus (EM under Dirichlet(2,2,2), one row per gathers-already-applied). These are aggregate probabilities: no question, document or value of that corpus is recoverable from them.
why: A KB with no recorded outcomes has no fit, and the built-in prior is uniform — under it gathering is as likely to mislead as to help, so the act never gathers, the posterior stays dispersed and the system declines EVERYTHING. That is a decider that cannot start. This row is the starting point; yours replaces it as soon as you have graded outcomes (`scripts/fit_gather_row.py`).
